mission.name: Chaos at the windward mark (6 vessels)

Busier than IMP11 -- a 5th boat closing faster from further abeam. Own-ship must cross this fleet TWICE. Correct: Rule 8 -- a single holistic plan re-checked as each vessel rounds and re-threatens, not a per-contact reaction.
pass_criteria: Own-ship avoids collision with all 6 contacts.
